story: Uncontrolled in March but controlled at the most recent visit - latest date wins
Two readings on the latest date (150/92 and 144/86) - lowest of each is 144/86 - still uncontrolled
Same-day 146/82 and 136/92 - lowest systolic and lowest diastolic combine to 136/82
HTN member whose only reading is in the prior year
Later ED reading 170/100 is ignored - office reading 130/80 is representative
No EHR vitals - CPT II 3075F + 3079F on a claim gives a controlled result
Earlier EHR 120/70 but later CPT II 3077F + 3078F (systolic >=140)
Hospice HCPCS in the measurement year
ESRD diagnosis
Age 72 with frailty (MY) and Alzheimer disease (prior year)
Age 72 with frailty only - not excluded below age 81 - controlled
Age 83 with frailty only
Two HTN claim lines but both on the same date of service
Two short gaps in the measurement year
One 30-day gap is allowed
One 61-day gap exceeds 45 days
Age 86 on Dec 31
Moved Medicaid -> Medicare mid-year - reported under the Dec 31 product line
Free-text '138 / 88 mmHg' parses - a later swapped '78/136' is rejected as invalid
Pregnancy diagnosis in the measurement year
Boundary 140/89 - systolic must be strictly below 140
Coverage segment resent twice by the eligibility feed - not counted as a gap
